vanilla_changes.change: Leaves with no log support decay much faster than vanilla; timing and whether leaves of different types connect are configurable.

editor_notes: Requires Puzzles Lib and Forge Config API Port. Pack has no config override for it.
name: Leaves Be Gone
summary: Leaves decay almost immediately after a tree is chopped down, typically within about a second, instead of lingering. Works with most modded leaves via the minecraft:leaves tag.
